name: Ightham Mote

dates.altered: Early-C16 crenellated brick parapet to the tower; the original chapel converted into two rooms 1521-27; a Jacobean-revival two-tier fireplace of 1866; panelling and fireplace surround by R Norman Shaw, 1872; Gothick glazing bars added circa 1800; a half-timbered dog-kennel added 1891.
dates.note: 'Present buildings date at least from circa 1340-1360, with much addition since' is the entry's own hedge and is kept.

quotes.text: House. Present buildings date at least from circa 1340-1360, with much addition since. Moated, 4 ranges round courtyard with smaller yard behind to east. West front 2 ranges either side of west tower.
quotes.page: Official list entry, Details, opening paragraph

quotes.text: Coursed rubble stone to left and right, the upper parts galletted, the lower ungalletted. Plain tiled roofs with end stacks. Central tower random rubble stone with early C16 crenellated brick parapet.
quotes.page: Official list entry, Details, opening paragraph, following the plan sentence

quotes.text: Two storeys to sides, 3-storey tower. Three windows either side of centre almost symmetrical, save first floor to left with one larger 3-light window with dripmould centrally-placed.
quotes.page: Official list entry, Details, west front description

quotes.text: Interior: Built circa 1340-60. Possibly never had a screens passage for there is a lancet of contemporary date where the answering doorway to the main entrance should have been.
quotes.page: Official list entry, Details, opening of the interior description

quotes.text: Trussed rafter roof with collar purlin and crown-post resting in stone sphare arch which rests on a pair of carved corbels.
quotes.page: Official list entry, Details, interior description of the hall roof

quotes.text: Crypt. Circa 1340-60,2 bays with pair of quadripartite rib vaults.
quotes.page: Official list entry, Details, interior description; the legacy text prints '1340-60,2 bays' with no space after the comma
